mapper.select:
select t.* from ( select st.*,att.* from SYS_TEMPLATE st left join ( select fa.file_name,fam.table_pk_value,fam.attachment_id,fa.source_pk_value from fnd_atm_attachment fa,fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam where fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id AND upper(fam.table_name) = 'SYS_TEMPLATE' ) att on att.table_pk_value = st.template_id ) t
t.enabled_flag='Y'
AND t.template_id = #{templateId}
AND t.description LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{description}),'%')
AND t.file_name LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{fileName}),'%')
AND ( t.description LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{queryInfo}),'%') or t.file_name LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{queryInfo}),'%') )
order by t.last_update_date desc
